What we offer

Three ways to fix your water, one place to start.

Whichever fits your home, every job starts the same way — a free water test so we know exactly what we're solving for.

Point of entry

Water Softeners

Removes hardness at the main line — protecting pipes, water heater, dishwasher, and washer. Available in 30,000 / 45,000 / 60,000 grain sizes.

Point of entry

Whole Home Filtration

Installed at your main water line, treating every tap in the house — reducing chlorine, sediment, VOCs and odour. Available in 10" and 20" housings.

Point of use

Reverse Osmosis

A dedicated drinking-water system with a 6 or 7-stage reverse osmosis process, removing dissolved contaminants and sharpening taste right at the tap.
